audit.method: Authenticated gh CLI: gh api repo metadata, commits/<ref>, git/trees/<full SHA>?recursive=1, contents/PATH?ref=<full SHA>.
audit.scope: Read-only repository metadata/tree/file/license verification. No large clones, application run, dependency installs, model inference, paid API use, dataset download, credentials inspected, service/infrastructure mutation, or source reuse.
limitations: main refs were sampled only to resolve a full immutable SHA; build instructions use SHA, never moving main
package/API compatibility and runnable usage not tested
code, model, and data/asset rights recorded separately; model/data statuses are not blanket legal clearance
Manifest embeds verified recursive tree blob paths to audit every source/license/package path without another GitHub request.
